_about: FICTIONAL test fixture for ~/bin/deadlines (canton ZZ, town Testhausen; matches the synthetic profile-tests profile). Structure mirrors a real ch-<canton>.json; places, hosts and law references are made up. Never use real data in tests.
_format: date: 'MM-DD' (every year) or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (once); window_end: 'MM-DD' for a period; workday: 'before' = if the date is a weekend/ZZ holiday, act on the working day before (conservative), 'after' = the legal deadline moves to the next working day; if: profile key in profile.json (null/unknown = 'if applicable', not synced); covered_by: another tool owns the reminders (sync skips it); remind: [{before: days}] lead times for `deadlines sync`; {year}/{prev}/{next}/{amount} placeholders use the occurrence year; verified: verified | partly | unverified.

deadlines.title: Collect tax documents for the {prev} return
deadlines.action: Lohnausweis, 3a certificate, bank/broker year-end statements arrive now: send them to paperless. `deadlines checklist tax {prev}` shows what's missing.
deadlines.notes: Lohnausweis usually Jan; banks' tax statements (eSteuerauszug) Jan–Feb; ESTV year-end Kursliste values usually final in Jan–Feb.

ESTV Kurslisten (ICTax), year-end values as of 31 Dec

deadlines.title: Federal tax (direkte Bundessteuer) {prev}: general due date
deadlines.action: Pay the federal tax bill within 30 days of receiving it. Prepaying earns nothing (0.0 % on voluntary advance payments in 2026); late interest 4 % (2026 and 2027).
deadlines.notes: EFD ordinance SR 642.124 Art. 1: general due date 1 March of the year after the tax year (text seen in the 2021 consolidation). Informational: no reminder, the bill itself is the trigger (bills tracker).

sources.title: EFD: Zinssätze für Abgaben und Steuern (4 % Verzugszins since 1 Jan 2026; 0.0 % on voluntary DBST advance payments)
ESTV: no change to federal interest rates for 2027
EFD-Verordnung über Fälligkeit und Verzinsung der direkten Bundessteuer (SR 642.124), Art. 1

deadlines.title: ZZ tax return {prev} due
deadlines.action: File via the ZZ tax software + eFiling (receipts uploaded as attachments), or request an extension online BEFORE the deadline: extension.zz.example/steuernnp (PID + date of birth), up to 30 Nov.
deadlines.notes: The canton sets the deadline each year (ZZR 641.111 § 82) and prints it on the form; 31 March is the standard date for employees (A7 research, consistent with the 30 Nov online-extension cap), but no official zz.example page stating it was found: check the date printed on the 2026 form. Extensions must be asked for before the deadline (StG Art. 1.6.2.4 Fristen).

sources.title: ZZ Verordnung über die direkten Steuern (ZZR 641.111) § 82: the cantonal tax administration sets the filing deadline; extension for important reasons
ZZ Steuerverwaltung: eFiling (receipts digitised as attachments)

deadlines.remind_text: File via eFiling, or extend online first (extension.zz.example/steuernnp, up to 30 Nov).

deadlines.title: Extended deadline for the tax return
deadlines.action: File the return now (the online extension goes to 30 Nov at most; longer only in exceptional cases via the Gemeinde tax office).

sources.title: ZZ eFristerstreckung natürliche Personen: 'Verlängerung der Einreichefrist bis maximal 30.11.'
Online form

deadlines.remind_text: The extended deadline is coming up: file via eFiling.

deadlines.title: ZZ/Gemeinde taxes {year}: 1st provisional instalment due
deadlines.action: Pay instalment 1 of 3 from the provisional tax bill (Testhausen tax office). 30-day payment term; paying early earns Ausgleichszins.

sources.title: ZZR 641.111 § 99: three instalments due on the 1st day of the 6th, 9th and 12th month; provisional bill at least 7 months before year end. StG Art. 177/178: three instalments, 30-day payment term

deadlines.remind_text: Instalment 1 of 3 (provisional bill from the Testhausen tax office); 30-day payment term.
deadlines.notes: Interest: Ausgleichszins in your favour on payments made before the final bill, against you from the Verfalltag (30 Sep); rate set yearly by the ZZ Finanzdepartement (last found: 1% Ausgleichs-/Vergütungszins, 5% Verzugszins from 1 Apr 2024; 2026 not confirmed).

deadlines.title: ZZ/Gemeinde taxes {year}: 2nd provisional instalment due
deadlines.action: Pay instalment 2 of 3. If instalments 1 and 2 are both unpaid, the whole year's tax falls due without a reminder (StG Art. 177).
deadlines.remind_text: Instalment 2 of 3. If 1 and 2 are both unpaid, the whole year falls due.
deadlines.notes: Interest: Ausgleichszins in your favour on payments made before the final bill, against you from the Verfalltag (30 Sep); rate set yearly by the ZZ Finanzdepartement (last found: 1% Ausgleichs-/Vergütungszins, 5% Verzugszins from 1 Apr 2024; 2026 not confirmed).

deadlines.title: ZZ/Gemeinde taxes {year}: 3rd provisional instalment due
deadlines.action: Pay instalment 3 of 3. Interest is settled with the final bill: in your favour on what you paid early, against you from the Verfalltag (30 Sep) on anything still open.

sources.title: ZZR 641.111 §§ 98–99 (Verfalltag = last day of the 9th month); ZZR 641.100 Art. 175 Ausgleichszinsen

deadlines.remind_text: Instalment 3 of 3; interest is settled with the final bill.
deadlines.notes: Interest: Ausgleichszins in your favour on payments made before the final bill, against you from the Verfalltag (30 Sep); rate set yearly by the ZZ Finanzdepartement (last found: 1% Ausgleichs-/Vergütungszins, 5% Verzugszins from 1 Apr 2024; 2026 not confirmed).

deadlines.title: Säule 3a {year}: pay in the maximum ({amount}) — it must be credited by 31 Dec
deadlines.action: Pay early (aim for mid-December: credit date counts, not debit date). Back-payment: once {year}'s full {amount} is in, you can also buy in a {prev} gap (first possible in 2026 for a 2025 gap; up to 10 years back, gaps from 2025 on only; one buy-in per gap year, max one 'small' amount per buy-in); deductible in the year paid.
deadlines.notes: Max for employees with a pension fund: 2026 CHF 7,258 (BSV), 2027 CHF 7,373 (from 1 Jan 2027, admin.ch 5 Oct 2026). Buy-in conditions (BSV FAQ): 3a-eligible with AHV-liable income both in the buy-in year and the gap year, and the maximum paid in the buy-in year.

sources.title: BSV: Beiträge Säule 3a ('spätestens am 31. Dezember … verbucht'; buy-ins from tax year 2026 for 2025; deductible in the year paid)
admin.ch 2026-10-05: Höchstabzüge Säule 3a im Steuerjahr 2027 (CHF 7,373)
BSV FAQ: Wie lange zurück sind Einkäufe in die Säule 3a möglich?
BSV FAQ: Bedingungen für einen Einkauf
BSV FAQ: maximaler Einkaufsbetrag ('kleiner Beitrag')
Bundesrat 2024-11-06: nachträgliche Einkaufsmöglichkeit in die Säule 3a (BVV 3, in force 1 Jan 2025)

deadlines.remind_text: Max {amount} for {year}; the credit date counts, so pay by mid-Dec. A {prev} gap can be bought in once {year} is full.

deadlines.title: Serafe household fee {year}: annual invoice ({amount})
deadlines.action: Pay within 60 days (annual invoice; quarterly invoices on request, due in 30 days). The bills tracker picks the invoice up.
deadlines.notes: Households are randomly split into 12 billing groups, each invoiced in a different month, so the month is individual: set serafe_invoice_date once the invoice shows up. Fee cut to CHF 312 from 1 Jan 2027 (RTVV change) and CHF 300 from 2029; the SRG initiative (CHF 200) was rejected on 8 Mar 2026.

sources.title: BAKOM: amount and billing (CHF 335; 12 billing groups; annual bills due in 60 days, quarterly in 30)
UVEK Faktenblatt 2: Haushalts- und Unternehmensabgabe (2027: CHF 312, from 2029: CHF 300)
BAKOM: Abgabe für Radio und Fernsehen

deadlines.title: Halbtax renews automatically: last day to cancel
deadlines.action: The Halbtax renews itself yearly; the invoice comes 2 months before. Cancel at least 1 month before renewal on swisspass.ch (Abos → Kündigungsinformationen) if you don't want it, or switch to a GA.
deadlines.remind_text: Keep it? Renewal invoice is out; cancel on swisspass.ch by this date if not.
deadlines.notes: halbtax_expiry = last day of the current validity (from swisspass.ch). With eBill there's no separate cancellation reminder from SBB.

sources.title: SBB: Halbtax kündigen (auto-renewal, invoice 2 months before, cancel 1 month before)

deadlines.title: GA renews automatically: last day to cancel
deadlines.action: Check the GA's renewal and cancellation date on swisspass.ch (assumed to work like the Halbtax: cancel about a month before renewal).
deadlines.remind_text: GA renewal coming: keep it or cancel on swisspass.ch.

deadlines.title: W-8BEN at your foreign broker expires
deadlines.action: Re-sign the W-8BEN in the broker's portal before it lapses, or US dividends get 30 % withheld instead of the 15 % treaty rate.
deadlines.remind_text: Re-sign the W-8BEN in your broker's portal (else 30 % US withholding instead of 15 %).
deadlines.notes: Valid from signing until the last day of the third succeeding calendar year (IRS). Foreign withholding tax on dividends is reclaimed/credited with form DA-1 filed with the ZZ tax return; the claim lapses 3 years after the end of the tax period.

sources.title: IRS: Instructions for Form W-8BEN ('ending on the last day of the third succeeding calendar year')
ESTV: Formular DA-1 (Steuerperiode 2025), filed with the tax return and Wertschriftenverzeichnis
ESTV Merkblatt DA-M (3-year lapse)
